focused_questions.issue: The terminal mark after the interlinear title reads as a single H/#-like sign rather than '##'. Whether it keys to the mark ending the marginal note b017 is unconfirmed. The final vowel of 'vārttika/ā' is unclear.
The overwritten first digit of the shelfmark and the cancelled leaf figures in b012 and b015 are illegible.

A facing fol.133b note (ff.1-12 ... Praṇava pañcīkaraṇa-vārttikābharaṇa ... No text of Śaṅkara or of original vārttika, with arrow) lies level with c.225(4). Its attachment is unverified and its wording is only partly legible at the supplied resolution.

The fol.133b note (Includes ... Dinapañjikā ..., abdapañjikā ..., Kālaśuddhi; the unbound packet is dated San 1283(=1876)?) with arrow probably refers to c.429. Its exact wording is not verified here.
The cancelled shelfmark, 'Vyādhi Śaṃkara', 'Scribe' and the extent '2: 11/12' are uncertain readings.

The struck word is not securely legible. The literal text should not present 'tīrtha' or the interlinear 'Śrī' as certain. Proposed literal_text: "d.548 (1)   ——   ——   D: Pañcīkaraṇavivaraṇa, by Ānanda⟦tīrtha?⟧ [Śrī? interlinear above] [k/o Suddhānanda? interlinear below].   n.d: 8: 10:\n0."

On the image the subtitle appears to be written with a single t and short a before -bharaṇa. It should not be silently regularised. Proposed literal_text: "√c.210 (6)   ff1-18, I.O.5949   ——,   ——, +DD: Pañcīkaraṇavārtikabharaṇa [reading?].   n.d.:\n18: 13: 0"
'ff.1-6' is written in the description position before the Weber reference, not in the extent column. It remains in literal_text. Proposed fields.extent: "6: 10/12: 0"
The written word is the title of a D: (commentary) within a ditto entry, not the holding's governing title. Proposed normalized_title: null

readings.source_reading: Pañcīkaraṇavārttik[a/ā?] followed by a single raised #/H-like sign
readings.evidence: Native tile (1604,1608): the mark above the end of the word is one hash- or H-like sign, not two. A stroke over the final letter may be a macron, so the final vowel could be a or ā. The b017 margin note ends 'vārttik[a/e?]' with a small raised star- or hash-like sign. The two signs look similar, but no line or arrow joins them.

readings.source_reading: b015: c.[3?]25 (4) with '2' written over or above the first digit; extent 13: ⟦1[3?]⟧ with 10/4 above. b012: extent 6: ⟦1[0/2?]⟧ with 10/12 above.
readings.evidence: Native tiles. The first digit of the b015 shelfmark looks like a struck 3 or 7. Both cancelled two-digit figures begin with '1', and the second digit is obscured by the strike.

readings.source_reading: fol.133b: 'ff.1-12. ⟦Fifth? ...⟧ [Called?] ⟦[illegible]⟧. Praṇava pañcīkaraṇa-vārttikābharaṇa. No text of Śaṅkara ← / or of original vārttika.' Left margin of the same page: 'For orig. text in 6 verses see Aufr. Oxf. I, p.226'?
readings.evidence: Adjacent native tile. The note sits at about y≈2050 on fol.133b, which is level with the c.225(4) line (y≈2100) on the target page. The arrow points toward the gutter. Being level does not prove attachment. Its ff.1-12 also does not obviously match the 13 leaves of c.225(4) or the ff1-18 of c.210(6).

readings.source_reading: fol.133b: 'Includes Dinapañjikā by [Durgācaraṇa?] Vipra, abdapañjikā by [Rāmacaraṇa?] Vipra, and Kālaśuddhi. The unbound packet is dated San 128[3?](=1876),' followed by an arrow
readings.evidence: Overview of fol.133b only, at reduced resolution. The note lies at about y≈3700, which is level with c.429 (y≈3750). Its reference to an 'unbound packet' matches b032. The personal names and the last digit of the year are not secure.
